description: This file contains definitions for permission checking methods used in the accounting module of the application. It defines various simple methods to verify user permissions for different accounting-related functionalities, such as preferences, transactions, invoices, and more, utilizing XML-based configurations.

methods.name: basePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has ACCOUNTING permission or higher privileges.

methods.name: basePlusRolePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has ACCOUNTING or ACCOUNTING_ROLE permissions.

methods.name: preferencePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has ACCTG_PREF permission.

methods.name: acctgFxPermissionCheck
methods.description: Verifies if the user has ACCTG_FX permission, or deprecated ACCTG_FX_ENTRY, with warning logging.

methods.name: acctgAgreementPermissionCheck
methods.description: Verifies overall accounting agreement permissions, combining role-based checks.

methods.name: commissionPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has ACCOUNTING_COMM permission.

methods.name: acctgCostPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks for basic ACCOUNTING cost permissions.

methods.name: acctgInvoicePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks invoice permissions with role considerations.

methods.name: acctgPaymentPermissionCheck
methods.description: Verifies permissions related to payments, considering roles.
